sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Galatia was an ancient Celtic land. It stood in central Anatolia. That region is now part of Turkey. Celts settled there in the third century B.C.E. St. Paul mentioned the region in his epistles. He wrote to the residents of the land.

okr.objective: Record the ancient Celtic land of Galatia.
